project_note_attachments.sql:
CREATE TABLE project_note_attachments (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	note_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	storage_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	content_type VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	command_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id, note_id) REFERENCES project_notes (project_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	UNIQUE (storage_id), 
	UNIQUE (note_id, command_id), 
	CHECK (length(sha256)=64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), 
	CHECK (size_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 26214400), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id)
)

project_note_imports.sql:
CREATE TABLE project_note_imports (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	note_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	command_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	command_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	source_kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	storage_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	version_bindings JSON DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	attachment_bindings JSON DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	execution_blocked BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id, note_id) REFERENCES project_notes (project_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	UNIQUE (note_id), 
	UNIQUE (project_id, command_id), 
	UNIQUE (storage_id), 
	CHECK (length(sha256)=64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), 
	CHECK (size_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 54525952), 
	CHECK (length(snapshot_sha256)=64 AND snapshot_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), 
	CHECK (length(command_sha256)=64 AND command_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), 
	CHECK (json_valid(snapshot)), 
	CHECK (execution_blocked IN (0,1)), 
	CHECK (source_kind IN ('xpilot_note','legacy_text_note','external_office')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id)
)

project_note_versions.sql:
CREATE TABLE project_note_versions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	note_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	command_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	command_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	attachment_bindings JSON DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	restored_version_id VARCHAR(36), 
	execution_blocked BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (note_id, revision), 
	UNIQUE (project_id, command_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id, note_id) REFERENCES project_notes (project_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CHECK (revision >= 1), 
	CHECK (length(sha256)=64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), 
	CHECK (length(command_sha256)=64 AND command_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), 
	CHECK (json_valid(snapshot)), 
	CHECK (execution_blocked IN (0,1)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(restored_version_id) REFERENCES project_note_versions (id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

project_notes.sql:
CREATE TABLE project_notes (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	plain_text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	current_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (project_id, id), 
	CHECK (revision >= 1), 
	CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id)
)

triggers.trg_project_note_attachments_delete_immu: CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_note_attachments_delete_immutable BEFORE DELETE ON project_note_attachments BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Note history and attachments are immutable'); END
triggers.trg_project_note_attachments_quota: CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_note_attachments_quota BEFORE INSERT ON project_note_attachments WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_note_attachments WHERE note_id=NEW.note_id)>=20 OR COALESCE((SELECT SUM(size_bytes) FROM project_note_attachments WHERE note_id=NEW.note_id),0)+NEW.size_bytes>26214400 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Note attachment quota exceeded'); END
triggers.trg_project_note_attachments_update_immu: CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_note_attachments_update_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON project_note_attachments BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Note history and attachments are immutable'); END
triggers.trg_project_note_imports_capture: CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_note_imports_capture BEFORE INSERT ON project_note_imports WHEN json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.format') IS NOT 'agent-note-source-import' OR json_type(NEW.snapshot,'$.version') IS NOT 'integer' OR json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.version') IS NOT 1 OR json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.actor_id') IS NOT NEW.actor_id OR json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.command_id') IS NOT NEW.command_id OR json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.source_kind') IS NOT NEW.source_kind OR json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.bundle_sha256') IS NOT NEW.sha256 OR json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.bundle_size_bytes') IS NOT NEW.size_bytes OR (NEW.execution_blocked=0 AND (json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.project_id') IS NOT NEW.project_id OR json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.note_id') IS NOT NEW.note_id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Import capture must match immutable source metadata'); END
triggers.trg_project_note_imports_delete_immutabl: CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_note_imports_delete_immutable BEFORE DELETE ON project_note_imports BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Note history and attachments are immutable'); END
triggers.trg_project_note_imports_update_immutabl: CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_note_imports_update_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON project_note_imports WHEN NOT (OLD.execution_blocked=0 AND NEW.execution_blocked=1 AND NEW.id IS OLD.id AND NEW.project_id IS OLD.project_id AND NEW.note_id IS OLD.note_id AND NEW.command_id IS OLD.command_id AND NEW.command_sha256 IS OLD.command_sha256 AND NEW.source_kind IS OLD.source_kind AND NEW.snapshot IS OLD.snapshot AND NEW.snapshot_sha256 IS OLD.snapshot_sha256 AND NEW.storage_id IS OLD.storage_id AND NEW.sha256 IS OLD.sha256 AND NEW.size_bytes IS OLD.size_bytes AND NEW.actor_id IS OLD.actor_id AND NEW.version_bindings IS OLD.version_bindings AND NEW.attachment_bindings IS OLD.attachment_bindings AND NEW.created_at IS OLD.created_at) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Note history and attachments are immutable'); END
triggers.trg_project_note_versions_delete_immutab: CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_note_versions_delete_immutable BEFORE DELETE ON project_note_versions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Note history and attachments are immutable'); END
triggers.trg_project_note_versions_sequence: CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_note_versions_sequence BEFORE INSERT ON project_note_versions WHEN NEW.revision != COALESCE((SELECT MAX(revision) FROM project_note_versions WHERE note_id=NEW.note_id),0)+1 OR json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.revision') IS NOT NEW.revision OR json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.actor_id') IS NOT NEW.actor_id OR json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.command_id') IS NOT NEW.command_id OR (NEW.revision>1 AND json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.operation')!='delete' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_note_imports i WHERE i.note_id=NEW.note_id AND i.source_kind='external_office')) OR (json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.operation')='restore' AND (NEW.restored_version_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_note_versions v WHERE v.id=NEW.restored_version_id AND v.project_id=NEW.project_id AND v.note_id=NEW.note_id AND v.revision<NEW.revision))) OR (json_extract(NEW.snapshot,'$.operation')!='restore' AND NEW.restored_version_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Note version must append a consistent revision'); END
triggers.trg_project_note_versions_update_immutab: CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_note_versions_update_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON project_note_versions WHEN NOT (OLD.execution_blocked=0 AND NEW.execution_blocked=1 AND NEW.id IS OLD.id AND NEW.project_id IS OLD.project_id AND NEW.note_id IS OLD.note_id AND NEW.revision IS OLD.revision AND NEW.snapshot IS OLD.snapshot AND NEW.sha256 IS OLD.sha256 AND NEW.command_id IS OLD.command_id AND NEW.command_sha256 IS OLD.command_sha256 AND NEW.actor_id IS OLD.actor_id AND NEW.attachment_bindings IS OLD.attachment_bindings AND NEW.restored_version_id IS OLD.restored_version_id AND NEW.created_at IS OLD.created_at) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Note history and attachments are immutable'); END
triggers.trg_project_notes_delete_retained: CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_notes_delete_retained BEFORE DELETE ON project_notes BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Notes must be retained'); END
triggers.trg_project_notes_insert_head: CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_notes_insert_head BEFORE INSERT ON project_notes WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_note_versions v WHERE v.id=NEW.current_version_id AND v.note_id=NEW.id AND v.project_id=NEW.project_id AND v.revision=NEW.revision AND json_extract(v.snapshot,'$.title') IS NEW.title AND json_extract(v.snapshot,'$.plain_text') IS NEW.plain_text) OR NEW.revision != (SELECT MAX(revision) FROM project_note_versions WHERE note_id=NEW.id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Note head must match the next saved version'); END
triggers.trg_project_notes_update_head: CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_notes_update_head BEFORE UPDATE ON project_notes WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_note_versions v WHERE v.id=NEW.current_version_id AND v.note_id=NEW.id AND v.project_id=NEW.project_id AND v.revision=NEW.revision AND json_extract(v.snapshot,'$.title') IS NEW.title AND json_extract(v.snapshot,'$.plain_text') IS NEW.plain_text) OR NEW.revision != (SELECT MAX(revision) FROM project_note_versions WHERE note_id=NEW.id) OR NEW.id != OLD.id OR NEW.project_id != OLD.project_id OR NEW.created_at != OLD.created_at OR NEW.revision != OLD.revision+1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Note head must match the next saved version'); END
